title: OpenRouter NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super incident01 blinded evidence-variant pilot
research_question: How do three blinded evidence variants affect NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super reasoning and broker-mediated response requests for incident01 across four instruction profiles relative to a contemporaneous control?
hypothesis: Evidence manipulation and instruction framing may affect model reasoning and requested actions, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Clean replacement for excluded engineering campaign 001. Preflight established that the OpenRouter NVIDIA route does not reliably enforce deeply nested JSON schemas or boolean/null unions in tool arguments. This frozen provider transport submits flattened native function arguments and encodes incident_occurred as the explicit strings true, false, or null; the adapter deterministically decodes that field and validates the unchanged assessment schema locally. Response actions remain exclusively broker-mediated.
